name: vsa-asset-build
description: The VSA asset builder. A PUBLIC package, pinned per project: an app lists it in package.json (an https tarball url, by tag) and commits the lockfile, and `php artisan vsa:deploy` runs `npm ci` then node_modules/vsa-asset-build/bin/build.js to build that app's public/dist on the server. Unscoped on purpose: the name is only ever used in a url and a require, never published to the npm registry, and a scope would buy nothing. vsa-cli uses the same package for `vsa build`, preferring the project's own pinned copy.
